We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons reaction (retro step). We have found a template 308619 with mapped_rxn from search result. However verify_step with one of the precursors from earlier (from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1) returned False. The earlier answer gave three possible precursor pairs (two precursors each). Those are likely the correct retrosynthetic disconnections for HWE: the phosphonate (or silyl protected) and aldehyde/ketone? The template we found may not match those. We need to find a template that when applied to the target yields those precursors.

We have the target SMILES: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

The precursors from earlier: three options:

1. ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO", "Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"]
2. ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO", "Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"]
3. ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C", "Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"]

These represent the product (alkene with silyl protected carboxyl?) and a silyl chloride? Actually HWE uses phosphonate (e.g., (EtO)2P(O)CH2CO2R) and aldehyde/ketone. Here maybe the phosphonate is Cl[Si]... not typical. Might be a silyl protecting group.

Nevertheless, we need to find a template that when applied to target yields those two precursors. We can try to apply each candidate template from database? We need to search for templates that produce two fragments matching those SMILES.

We can use apply_template to see results for a given template. But we need to find template ID. Could search by product SMILES? The search function requires criteria; maybe we can search for templates that break C-P bond? But functional groups list includes "phosphonate"? Not in list. Maybe "alkyl halide" etc.

Alternative: Use get_available_functional_groups to see list.
